method: Independent primary-source review: source_review_34 read all 22 batch 3 cases, and delegated independent reviewer source_review_34/review_batch4 read all 20 batch 4 cases. Captions, relevant full paragraphs, surrounding reasoning, procedural history, dates, dispositions and source pinpoints were compared against the ledgers. Source PDFs were visually inspected where date layout or election tables warranted it. This verifies cited summaries and source attribution; it is not an exhaustive career or subsequent-history citator audit.

findings.finding: The unsupported 48-hour-waiver appellate argument was forfeited without a merits determination. Canonical ledger and part3b now say so.

notes: K.F. cover visually says Filed January 23, 2023, despite a separate earlier rehearing-denial line; current filed date follows the official displayed field.
Smith v. Smith has a Rule 23 notice despite no -U in the printed citation; the ledger preserves that distinction.
Page retained appellate jurisdiction and required a suppression hearing; no suppression ruling is falsely attributed to Walton.
Gavin reversal concerned insufficient proof, not a merits rejection of the evidentiary rulings.
Mays trial occurred April 25, 2019; sentence was imposed October 3, 2019. The trial date field denotes trial, not every later act.

Maloney and Mulroe have no included ruling, with explicit bounded search limitations. The additional independent search in extra-cook-gaps.json found zero new attributable rulings; it does not prove no such rulings exist.
